camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro CreateDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4pnum0000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --DatabaseName sms_pre --Encoding utf8mb4
description_en: Creates a database under a specified tenant
description_zh: 在指定租户下创建一个新的数据库
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro create-database --database-name sms_pre --tenant-id t4pnum0000 --encoding utf8mb4 --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.
You cannot use certain reserved keywords. Examples: test, sys, oceanbase, information_schema, mysql, and performance_schema
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。
不能使用某些预留关键字。例如：test, sys,oceanbase, information_schema, mysql, performance_schema
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Only the OceanBase MySQL mode is supported
parameters.help_zh: 租户 ID。仅支持 OceanBase MySQL 模式
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The encoding format of the database. Valid values: utf8mb4, utf16, gbk, gb18030, and binary
parameters.help_zh:
数据库编码方式。  
目前支持 utf8mb4, utf16, gbk, gb18030, binary
parameters.name: encoding

parameters.help_en:
The collation. Valid values:
If Encoding is set to utf8mb4: utf8mb4_general_ci, utf8mb4_bin, and utf8mb4_unicode_ci.
If Encoding is set to utf16: utf16_general_ci, utf16_unicode_ci, and utf16_bin.
If Encoding is set to gbk: gbk_chinese_ci and gbk_bin.
If Encoding is set to gb18030: gb18030_chinese_ci and gb18030_bin.
If Encoding is set to binary: binary
parameters.help_zh:
字符序。目前支持的字符序为：
Encoding 为 utf8mb4 时, Collation 支持 utf8mb4_general_ci,utf8mb4_bin,utf8mb4_unicode_ci。
Encoding 为 utf16 时, Collation 支持 utf16_general_ci,utf16_unicode_ci,utf16_bin。
Encoding 为 gbk 时, Collation 支持 gbk_chinese_ci,gbk_bin。
Encoding 为 gb18030 时, Collation 支持 gb18030_chinese_ci,gb18030_bin。
Encoding 为 binary 时, Collation 支持 binary
parameters.name: collation

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests.
The client token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。 从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。
ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token
